dedupe_keys.name: monthly coal mine level methane emission dataset for china 2018 2024

description: This dataset gives monthly methane emissions for over 3,000 coal mines across China, excluding Taiwan, from 2018 to 2024. The Zenodo record says it combines multi-source coal production data with a hybrid IPCC Tier 2 and Tier 3 method, and lists mine name, province and prefecture city, coordinates, production capacity, mining type, methane emission factors and monthly emissions, with national coal mine methane rising from 25.10 Mt in 2018 to 32.87 Mt in 2024. It was published in July 2026 by a research team led by Cui Yuxuan under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file of about 4.7 MB. Coverage is mainland China. Caveats: emissions are estimated, not measured, and the author affiliations and validation are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives geolocated coal mines with capacity and mining type to model coal supply, mine safety gas hazard and methane mitigation. Related catalogue records include the China coal mine closure methane scenarios and the gridded coal mine methane inventory for India and Australia.
name: Monthly coal mine-level methane emission dataset for China, 2018-2024
provider: Cui Yuxuan, Wang Ke and co-authors (research team), via Zenodo
